x-m-h3-08.title: Waxay tidhaahdaa togan, laakiin qofku runtii ma buka?

x-m-h3-08.s.s1.explain: Kuwa imtixaanka togan ka helay waxay ka kooban yihiin ‘dadka buka ee togan ka helay’ iyo ‘dadka caafimaadka qaba ee togan ka helay’. x-m-h3-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma barbar dhigtay ‘dadka buka ee togan’ iyo ‘dadka caafimaadka qaba ee togan’ tirooyin?

x-m-h3-04.title: Waxaan ku darayay lambarro togan oo keliya, laakiin wadarku waa −1?
x-m-h3-04.goal: Fahan shuruudda lagu qaadan karo wadarka taxane aan dhammaad lahayn inuu yahay hal lambar, oo laftaada samee taxane joomatari ah oo buuxiya shuruudda.
x-m-h3-04.material: Arday ayaa helay wadarka ‘1 + 2 + 4 + 8 + …’ sida hoos ku qoran. Dhammaan erayadu waa togan yihiin, laakiin wadarku wuxuu soo baxay mid taban.

x-m-h3-04.thinking.1: Dabaq shuruudda wadarka taxanaha joomatariga ah ee aan dhammaadka lahayn inuu jiro, shuruudaha gudahooda
x-m-h3-04.thinking.2: Samee tusaalayaal kala duwan oo buuxiya shuruudda
x-m-h3-04.prereq.0: Khibrad barashada xadka isku xigxigyada iyo wadarrada taxanayaasha aan dhammaadka lahayn
x-m-h3-04.prereq.1: Khibrad liis garaynta erayada isku xigxig joomatari ah
x-m-h3-04.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal safaf oo dhibaatadu marka hore ka dhacdo xalka ardayga.
x-m-h3-04.s.s1.hint.0: Safaf kasta, qor 'waxa marka hore run ahaan lahaa si safkani u noqdo sax' oo hubi haddii runtii ay run tahay.
x-m-h3-04.s.s1.hint.1: Laftaada qor wadarrada qayb-qayb ah S₁, S₂, S₃, S₄ oo eeg sida ay isu beddelaan.
x-m-h3-04.s.s1.line.0: Ka soo qaad wadarka si aan dhammaad lahayn loo daray S = 1 + 2 + 4 + 8 + … waxaa la go'aamiyay inuu yahay lambar dhab ah.
x-m-h3-04.s.s1.line.1: Ku dhufashada labada dhinac 2 waxay siinaysaa 2S = 2 + 4 + 8 + 16 + ….
x-m-h3-04.s.s1.line.2: Dhinaca midig waa S oo laga saaray eraygii koowaad 1, sidaas darteed 2S = S − 1.
x-m-h3-04.s.s1.line.4: Waxaan sii ku darayay lambarro togan oo keliya, laakiin wadarku wuxuu noqday −1.
x-m-h3-04.s.s1.explain: Bilowgu waa safka 1, kaas oo u malaystay S inuu yahay lambar dhab ah. Wadarrada qayb-qayb ah ee taxanahan waa 1, 3, 7, 15, …, kuwaas oo sii weynaada si aan dhammaad lahayn, sidaas darteed ma jiro lambar wadarka lagu go'aamiyo. Haddii aad u malaysato in lambar jiro oo aan jirin, oo aad beddesho tibaaxda, qiime macno darro ah sida safka 4 ayaa soo bixi kara.
x-m-h3-04.s.s2.prompt: Samee 2 lammaane (a, r), oo leh r kala duwan, si wadarka taxanaha joomatariga ah ee aan dhammaadka lahayn ee leh eray koowaad a iyo saamiga guud r uu yahay 5. (Tobanlayaal waa la oggol yahay, r ≠ 0)
x-m-h3-04.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore xusuuso baaxadda saamiga guud uu ku jiro si wadarku u jiro.
x-m-h3-04.s.s2.hint.1: Marka hore go'aami r, ka dibna hagaaji a si wadarku u noqdo 5.
x-m-h3-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Qiimaha saafiga ah ee saamiga guud wuu ka yar yahay 1, sidaas darteed wadarku wuu jiraa.
x-m-h3-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Haddii saamiga guud r uu yahay 0 ama qiimihiisa saafiga ah uu yahay ugu yaraan 1, wadarka lama go'aamiyo sidii lambar.
x-m-h3-04.s.s2.explain: Si wadarku u jiro, |r| < 1 ayaa loo baahan yahay, haddii wadarku yahay 5-na a = 5(1 − r). Tusaale ahaan, haddii r = 0.4, markaas a = 3, haddii r = −0.2-na, markaas a = 6. a = −5, r = 2 waxay ku habboon yihiin qaacidada a = 5(1 − r) oo keliya, sidaas darteed wadarku ma jiro.

x-m-h3-01.title: Integral-ka go'an waa 0, laakiin ma bedku sidoo kale waa 0?
x-m-h3-01.goal: Ogow in qiimaha integral go'an iyo bedka shaxda ay kala duwanaan karaan, hel safka halka dhibaatada xalka ay ka bilaabato, oo dooro habka saxa khaladka.
x-m-h3-01.material: Arday ayaa helay bedka aagga ay xidhaan qalooca y = x² − 4x + 3, ulaha x, iyo labada xariiq x = 0 iyo x = 3 sida hoose. (Erayo halkii sawir: qaloocan wuxuu ku kulmaa ulaha x x = 1 iyo x = 3; marka x u dhexeeyo 0 iyo 1 wuxuu ka sarreeyaa ulaha x, marka x u dhexeeyo 1 iyo 3 na wuxuu ka hooseeyaa ulaha x.)
x-m-h3-01.thinking.0: Kala saar haddii saf kasta uu ka yimid safka hore iyo haddii dejintu laftigeedu ku habboon tahay hadafka
x-m-h3-01.thinking.1: Sharax sababta khaladka adigoo isticmaalaya macnaha calaamadda integral go'an
x-m-h3-01.thinking.2: Barbar dhig oo qiimee hababka saxa khaladka
x-m-h3-01.prereq.0: Khibrad xisaabinta integral-yada go'an ee shaqooyinka polynomial
x-m-h3-01.prereq.1: Khibrad barashada xiriirka u dhexeeya integral-yada go'an iyo bedka hoostiisa qalooca
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal safka xalka ardayga ee dhibaatada koowaad ka dhacdo. (Qaar ka mid ah safafka waxay leeyihiin xisaabo sax ah.)
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.hint.0: Akhri saf kasta oo hubi ‘ma si toos ah ayay uga timid safka hore?’
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.hint.1: Xitaa haddii xisaabtu sax tahay, hubi haddii xisaabtaasi hesho waxa aad ula jeeday inaad hesho. Xusuuso, dhexe kasta, qaybtee ee qalooca iyo ulaha x dhexdooda ah ayuu qiimaha safka 4 tiriyey, iyo calaamad noocee ah.
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.line.0: Ha noqoto f(x) = x² − 4x + 3, S na ha noqoto bedka u dhexeeya qalooca iyo ulaha x dhexda [0, 3].
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.line.1: Dhig S = ∫₀³ f(x) dx. (integral-ka go'an ee f(x) laga bilaabo 0 ilaa 3)
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.line.2: F(x) = x³/3 − 2x² + 3x waa antiderivative ee f(x).
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.line.4: Sidaas darteed S = 0. Inkasta oo si cad ay u jirto aag u dhexeeya qalooca iyo ulaha x, bedku wuxuu u soo baxay 0.
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.explain: Xisaabaha (safafka 3 iyo 4) waa sax. Dhibaatadu waa dejinta safka 2. Integral go'an waa qiime tirinaya qaybta ka sarreysa ulaha x sida + iyo qaybta ka hooseysa sida −, sidaas darteed 4/3 ee [0,1] iyo −4/3 ee [1,3] way is-baabi'iyaan oo waxay samaysaan 0. Bedku ma eego calaamadda, sidaas darteed gabagabada safka 5 sidoo kale waa khalad ka timaada dejintaas.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.prompt: Dooro habka ku habboon ee lagu helo bedka sax ah.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir sababta integral-ka go'an u noqday 0 adigoo u kala qaybinaya qaybaha sare iyo hoose.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.hint.1: Barbar dhig mid mid haddii habkasta uu tiriyo labadaba qaybta ka sarreysa ulaha x iyo tan ka hooseysa sida bed togan.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.o.a: Hel integral-ka go'an [0, 3] oo dhan, ka dibna qaado qiimaha saafiga ah ee qiimahaas sida bedka
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.r.a: Wadartu waxay noqotay 0 sababtoo ah qaybaha sare iyo hoose way is-baabi'iyeen. Xitaa haddii aad qaadato qiimaha saafiga ah kadib marka la is-baabi'iyey, bedka labada qaybood dib uma yimaado.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.o.b: Ka tag dhexda halka qalooca uu ka hooseeyo ulaha x, oo isku dar dhexda halka uu ka sarreeyo oo keliya
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.r.b: Qaybta ka hooseysa ulaha x sidoo kale waa aag ay xidhaan qalooca iyo ulaha x. Calaamaddeedu oo keliya ayaa ah −, laakiin bedka qaybtaas waa togan.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.o.c: U kala qaybi dhexda x = 1 halka calaamadda ay isbeddesho, qaado qiimaha saafiga ah ee integral-ka go'an ee dhexe kasta, oo isku dar
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.r.c: Habkani wuxuu u kala qaybiyaa halka calaamadda ay isbeddesho wuxuuna si gooni gooni ah u tiriyaa qaybaha sare iyo hoose.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.o.d: Hel celceliska f(0) iyo f(3) labada dhammaad, ka dibna ku dhufo dhererka dhexda 3 si aad u hesho bedka
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.r.d: Qaloocu ma aha xariiq toosan, sidaas darteed celceliska qiimayaasha dhammaadka ma beddeli karo qalooca oo dhan.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.explain: U kala qaybinta x = 1 waxay siinaysaa ∫₀¹ f = 4/3 iyo ∫₁³ f = −4/3, bedkuna waa 4/3 + |−4/3| = 8/3.
x-m-h3-01.s.s3.prompt: Qor fariin saaxiib isticmaalay xalkan, u sheegaya sida ‘qiimaha integral go'an’ iyo ‘bedku’ ugu kala duwanaadeen dhibaatadan iyo waxa bedka sax ah yahay.
x-m-h3-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qor qaybta sare iyo qaybta hoose mid kasta erayo.
x-m-h3-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ugu dambeyntii, qor bedka sax ah sida lambar.
x-m-h3-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Sharaxaaddaada, ma ku xidhan tahay sababta integral-ka go'an u noqday 0 qaybaha sare iyo hoose?
x-m-h3-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma tiri, adigoo isticmaalaya tirooyin, sida aad u heshay bedka sax ah?
x-m-h3-01.s.s3.model.0: Integral go'an wuxuu tiriyaa qaybta ka hooseysa ulaha x sida taban, sidaas darteed 4/3 ee sare iyo −4/3 ee hoose way is-baabi'iyaan si ay u sameeyaan 0. Bedka waxaa lagu helaa u kala qaybinta dhexda x = 1 iyo ku darista qiimayaasha saafiga ah, taasoo ah 8/3.
x-m-h3-01.s.s3.model.1: ∫ waa qiime tirinaya qaybta sare sida + iyo qaybta hoose sida −, sidaas darteed 0 ayaa soo baxay. Bedku waa 4/3 ee [0,1] iyo qaybta hoose 4/3 ee [1,3], sidaas darteed wadajir waa 8/3.
